name: dotworkout-monorepo
description: TypeScript codec and authoring library for Apple .workout files
author: Javier Ferrer Sánchez-Barcaiztegui

scripts.generate: npm run generate:proto && npm run generate:constraints
scripts.build: tsc -b packages/codec packages/domain packages/notation packages/mcp packages/pwa/tsconfig.test.json
scripts.clean: tsc -b --clean packages/codec packages/domain packages/notation packages/mcp packages/pwa/tsconfig.test.json
scripts.check: npm run generate && npm run test
